---
title: "Day 3 Revision: SEACRERD Model (Partial vs. Complete Waning Immunity)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk[["set"]](echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(deSolve)
```

## 1. SEACRERD Model Dynamics
Here we track both **complete waning immunity** (`R -> S` at rate `alpha`) and **partial/leaky immunity** (`R -> ER` at reduced susceptibility `sigma * lam`). Secondary exposures (`ER`) progress exclusively into mild/asymptomatic infection (`A`), protecting against clinical disease (`C`) and death (`D`).

```{r seacrerd-model}
SEACRERD <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # Total living population includes secondary exposed (ER)
    P <- (S + E + A + C + R + ER)
    
    # Force of infection includes primary (E) and secondary (ER) pre-symptomatic shedding
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * (rho * A + C + delta * E + delta_r * ER) / P
    
    dS  <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S + alpha * R  
    dE  <- lam * S - v * E - mu * E
    # Note: Both primary (1-gamma)*v*E and ALL secondary (v*ER) cases enter A
    dA  <- (1 - gamma) * v * E - taua * A - mu * A + v * ER
    dC  <- gamma * v * E - tauc * C - mu * C 
    # R loses individuals via natural death (mu), reinfection (sigma*lam), and full waning (alpha)
    dR  <- (1 - phi) * tauc * C + taua * A - mu * R - sigma * lam * R - alpha * R
    dER <- sigma * lam * R - v * ER - mu * ER
    dD  <- phi * tauc * C
    
    list(c(dS, dE, dA, dC, dR, dER, dD))
  }) 
}

# Initial conditions (P = 999, 1 initial clinical case)
initP <- 999 
initE <- 0
initA <- 0
initC <- 1
initR <- 0 
initER <- 0
initD <- 0
initS <- initP - initE - initA - initC - initR - initER
istate <- c(S = initS, E = initE, A = initA, C = initC, R = initR, ER = initER, D = initD)

parameters <- c(
  mu = (1 / (50 * 52 * 7)),    
  beta = 0.25, 
  v = 1 / 4,        # 4-day latent period (for both E and ER)
  gamma = 0.2,      # 20% clinical fraction for primary infections
  taua = 1 / 10,    # 10-day asymptomatic duration
  tauc = 1 / 10,    # 10-day clinical duration
  phi = 0.05,       # 5% CFR among clinical cases
  rho = 1,          # Relative infectiousness of A
  sigma = 0.5,      # Relative susceptibility to reinfection while in R (50% immune)
  alpha = 1 / 180,  # Complete immunity waning rate (180 days)
  delta_r = 0.0,    # Pre-symptomatic infectiousness of secondary exposed (ER)
  delta = 0.0       # Pre-symptomatic infectiousness of primary exposed (E)
)

time_start <- 0
time_stop <- 600
deltat <- 0.1
tps <- seq(time_start, time_stop, by = deltat)

out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRERD, parms = parameters) 
Result <- as.data.frame(out)

# Plot all 7 compartments over time and phase plane S vs (A + C)
plot(out)
plot(Result[["S"]], Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]], type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 300), xlim = c(0, 1000),
     xlab = "Susceptible (S)", ylab = "Active Infected (A + C)",
     main = "SEACRERD Phase Plane")
```

## 2. Parameter Sweep: Transmission (`beta`) vs. Complete Waning (`alpha`)
Here we vary `beta` (0.1 to 2.9) and `alpha` (0.003 to 0.01) to see how transmission and complete immunity loss jointly sustain endemic clinical cases (`out[, 5]`, column `C`) at Day 600.

```{r contour-beta-alpha}
beta_vector <- seq(0.1, 3, by = 0.2)
alpha_vector <- seq(0.003, 0.01, by = 0.001)
result <- matrix(0, nrow = length(beta_vector), ncol = length(alpha_vector))

for (i in 1:length(beta_vector)) {
  for (j in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
    parameters["beta"] <- beta_vector[i]
    parameters["alpha"] <- alpha_vector[j]
    
    out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRERD, parms = parameters) 
    
    # Column 5 is C (Clinical cases) at Day 600
    result[i, j] <- tail(out[, 5], 1)
  }
}

contour(result, xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xlab = "Transmission Rate (beta)", 
        ylab = "Complete Waning Rate (alpha)", nlevels = 10, labcex = 1.2, 
        col = hcl.colors(12, "Temps"), lwd = 2,
        main = "Endemic Clinical Cases (C) at Day 600")
axis(1, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(beta_vector)), labels = beta_vector)
axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(alpha_vector)), labels = alpha_vector)
```
